steps.content:
The root cause is instance family **lGXWXGViUW** in account S5Tfd67. It runs in cloud service caGYw for application kt5.

This resource follows a regular weekly pattern. Through mid-October it ran 18 instances on Monday to Wednesday at about $172.80 a day. On Thursday and Friday it dropped to 8–9 instances, costing $76.80–$86.40, and on weekends it ran 0–1 instances, costing $0–$9.60.

On Thursday 2025-10-16 it did not scale down. It stayed at 18 instances and cost $172.80, about $86 more than a normal Thursday. The price per instance stayed the same, so the extra cost comes entirely from the higher instance count. It stayed at 18 instances again on Friday 10/17. From then on it ran at full size Monday to Friday, which suggests the scheduled Thursday/Friday scale-down stopped working.

At the service and application level, caGYw and kt5 rose by roughly the same amount over this period. No other instance family changed meaningfully on 10/16. Another family, TG1W6dFF47, spiked on 10/13–14 but was back to normal by 10/16, so it isn't part of this anomaly.
